Each trigger represents a distinct pathway for data flow into the system. The Vercel cron provides stable, high-frequency ingestion with 31 entries. GitHub Actions introduces a contingent path dependent on external resources, modeled as a probabilistic condition. The local daemon enables arbitrary file ingestion, forming a non-standard but critical data ingress point. These paths intersect in a directed graph where each node represents a data source and edge a trigger. Coverage completeness is determined by verifying all scheduled paths and identifying orphaned routes. Failure modes include schedule divergence, runner idleness, and daemon crash. The system's robustness depends on redundancy and fallback mechanisms.
